description: This file defines React components and hooks for managing and displaying references related to notes within the Notesnook project. It includes components for listing linked notes and references, handling internal links, and managing expansion state.

classes.name: useExpandedStore
classes.description: A Zustand store hook managing expansion state of note items.

classes.name: ListBlockItem
classes.description: Component rendering individual content blocks with a preview and type indicator.

classes.name: ListNoteInternalLink
classes.description: Component rendering internal links within notes with highlighted text.

classes.name: ListNoteItem
classes.description: Component rendering a note item with expandable content blocks or internal links.

classes.name: ReferencesList
classes.description: Main component displaying linked notes and references for a given item, with tab switching.

methods.name: ReferencesList.present
methods.description: Static method to present the ReferencesList component as a sheet modal.
